recipes.recipe_name: Massoppu Saaru (Authentic Karnataka)
recipes.method: Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric. Wash and chop the greens, then pressure-cook them with the dal, green chilli, onion and tomato. Mash to a loose curry, simmer with tamarind and rasam powder, then finish with a garlic-mustard-cumin-curry-leaf tempering. Serve with ragi mudde or rice.
recipes.notes: Added from web research because the user requested an authentic Mossoppu/Massoppu recipe. This is a separate recipe-book entry; it does not replace the planned lunch rows automatically.

recipes.recipe_name: Ragi Mudde
recipes.method: Make a thin slurry with a small portion of the ragi flour and water, bring it to a boil, then add the remaining flour and cook on low heat. Mix thoroughly until smooth and lump-free, steam briefly, then shape the hot cooked dough into balls with wet hands. Serve with saaru or sambar.
recipes.notes: Source reports about 155 kcal and 3 g protein per ragi mudde; recipe yields 5 balls. Added to Recipe Book only, not scheduled because the uploaded week currently specifies rice with Mossoppu.
